title: Renaming a rep updates their name on every customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}; customer {Customer-B} has {Sales-rep-B} as its one sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Other.
  • Starting screen: {Sales-rep-B}'s staff record is open in Settings > Staff in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change {Sales-rep-B}'s last name (for example to "Brook").
  2. Save the staff record.
  3. Open {Customer-A}'s page.
  4. Open {Customer-B}'s page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the new last name shows in the staff record.
  • Step 2: the staff record saves.
  • Step 3: Service Parts shows {Sales-rep-B}'s new name.
  • Step 4: "Sales Representative" also shows {Sales-rep-B}'s new name.
